read_for: put on (enduo G1746), all its faces: the body clothed with the imperishable (1Co 15:53-54), putting on Christ, the new self, the armour, compassion and love, and literal clothing: the inner act the clothing verb names, and when it is only clothing
why: the OT-05 cuts placed G1746 in A1 (the body changed) and A3 (clothing); its figurative faces, putting on Christ or the new self, were not read as such
comes_back_when: when M45 Renewal and transformation or M76 Walk and conduct is read as a strand
